note: Old -> new keys and values after the data_group normalisation. Apply to the React side.

structural.change: field_config.class_name moved to block level as fields_class_name
structural.detail: the grid of the rendered fields is now fields_class_name, a sibling of field_config, so field_config holds field names only; class_name stays the class of the element itself (ui.class_name on a field, row_options.class_name)
children is always a list, also with one element
hidden_when is always a list of conditions
src is always a list of source functions
sort_by / sort_field / order_field / sort_order(string) are now sort:{field,direction}
group_field / group_fields / group_by_field are now group_by, always an array

structural.change: is_fixed_group -> fixed_group (field, timeline_config key is_fixed_group_field -> fixed_group_field, lookup_nest_moments key, lane_item column)
structural.detail: is_ marks a boolean; fixed_group is the delivery class (text) the item is fixed to. 2026-09-05

structural.change: lane_item.level (0/1) -> lane_item.type (plan | progress | actual; action.lookup lookup_lane_item_type)
structural.detail: level said planned/realized as a number; type names the kind of row in words and can grow. progress is derived at read time, never stored. Output column level -> type (+ type_json), timeline_config.type_field + type_sort_order_field (type_json.sort_order; the kind class_names are merged into class_names). 2026-09-05

structural.change: data_group production_resource_plan (81) -> resource_plan, production_resource_plan_filter (82) -> resource_plan_filter; impose_resource_plan (78) archived; page impose-resource-plan -> resource-plan
structural.detail: one resource board for every step, steps and types as filters (action.get_resource_plan replaces mock.get_production_plan and the resource mode of get_impose_plan). 2026-09-05

structural.change: kinds of rows on a timeline: set_field, set_order_field, placement_field, evaluate {formula_field, params_field}, set_overrides {<set>: {field_config}}, items {data_field, offset_field, duration_field, class_names_field}
structural.detail: resource_plan (81) reuses the vocabulary of 19/29/56/76: a kind of row is a set, per-set differences are set_overrides keyed by the set value, the formula mechanism is evaluate, the sub level of a row is items with a data_field. No type_field, lane_item_config or segment_config. 2026-09-06

structural.change: text_field, label_field, i18n_field, content_field, set_title_field, gauge_title_field -> title_field; label_suffix_field -> title_suffix_field
structural.detail: one text slot for every config, whatever the value (a plain text or an i18n node); title is the standard text slot. 2026-09-06

structural.change: start_offset_in_seconds_field -> offset_field, end_offset_in_seconds_field -> end_offset_field, duration_in_seconds_field -> duration_field, segment_size_in_seconds_field -> segment_size_field, next_start_offset_in_seconds_field -> next_start_offset_field; scale_field removed (time_scale_config.input_data, 75/76/81)
structural.detail: the unit belongs to the field name, not to the key that points at it; scale_field pointed at the same field as duration_field. 2026-09-06

structural.change: is_atomic_field -> no_split_field, is_fixed_offset_field -> is_pinned_field, rank_field -> order_field, set_group_field -> set_group_fields (list), params_field next to evaluate -> evaluate.params_field (19, 56)
structural.detail: the old pv2 board and the state timeline use the words of 75/76/81. 2026-09-06
every chart names its x axis x_field. 2026-09-06
a string with placeholders is a template, not a field. 2026-09-06

keys.where: next to field_config: block, tooltip section, group, label_options
stacked_bar_chart_config, it holds a template string
row_options, label_options: one column, one key
INVERTED: was the levels a drag may cross, now the levels it may not; every entry is a group_by level
row_options, label_options; the column itself is copy_index (was occurence)

ui_control_type.rule: type says what the value is, control says how it is rendered

dropped_control.detail: control date/datetime next to a type, type wins

new_keys.detail: how far a shift chains: across the lanes of the plan, or within the lane
upper bound of the column width, counterpart of column_min_width
the display column per group_by level, same order, position for position; group_by itself holds ids only
everything only the drop reads; see docs/contracts/drag-and-drop.md
